description: Non-ARQ D_PDUs to a group this node belongs to, and to broadcast, are delivered; one to a group it does not belong to is ignored.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). groups is [0.0.2.1]. Every D_PDU is a single-segment type 7 from 0.0.1.3, GROUP ADDRESS set, address size 7, EOW 0, EOT 10, reception window 0, whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU (priority 0, SAP 9 to SAP 5, no TTD). At 2000: C_PDU ID 1 to group 0.0.2.1 (U_PDU "g1"), ID 2 to group 0.0.2.2 (U_PDU "g2"), ID 3 to broadcast 15.255.255.255, the all-ones 28-bit address (U_PDU "bc"). The first and third are addressed to this node (C-0566, A-0119, C-0123) and complete, so each is delivered with S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1, destination the group address with its group flag set, tx mode 2, source SAP 9, source 0.0.1.3. Window 0 means no reception window timer (zero-duration rule). The second is ignored.
